text:
jenna-cs: FYI getting escalations from 3 enterprise customers — sudden 401s across their API traffic starting ~07:12 UTC. They say nothing changed on their side. Can we confirm if the scheduled key rotation completed?

mike-oncall: on it. seeing spike in auth 401 rate on dashboards (auth-service). Baseline 0.2% -> 9% at 07:12. Also small spike in 5xxs. Collecting logs now.

alisha-infra: I can see rotation job finished at 07:10:19 UTC for keyset v3. Sync job to regions reported success but with warnings about stale cache invalidations to redis: "error deleting prefix replay_cache:kid:v2" — trying re-run.

aaron-eng: quick hypothesis: replay/kv cache still containing old key mappings which our validators consult. If rotation removed the old kid mapping before cache eviction, tokens signed with v2 might be rejected. Need to check validation path: does the service check kid->pubkey from local cache or query keyservice?

mike-oncall: here's a failing curl from a customer repro (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_old_v2" https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< x-request-id: rq_01F...
< content-type: application/json
{ "error": "invalid_token", "reason": "signature_verification_failed (kid v2)" }
```

lucy-support: impacted customers: AcmeML, Ledgerly, and CoveHealth. They've all opened support tickets and asked for ETA. CoveHealth is particularly nervous due to ongoing demos.

sam-product: we need an ETA and rollback plan. If rollback is safest, what's the risk/effort?

alisha-infra: I can re-run the key-sync job but that won't restore the deleted mapping if our key rotation state machine marked v2 as deprecated and removed metadata. Option A: re-introduce v2 mapping into keyservice and warm caches. Option B: rollback rotation (if we have previous deployment artifact) to re-enable legacy validation.

aaron-eng: reintroducing mapping is less disruptive but depends on whether we still have v2 private key material in key management. Ops: do we?

alisha-infra: I checked KMS history — v2 private key archived but recoverable via key rotation history. It will take ~15-25m to restore and propagate.

mike-oncall: immediate mitigation idea: enable permissive validation flag that falls back to keyservice lookup when local cache fails. That should let tokens validated while we restore mapping. Is there a runtime flag?

aar on-eng: there is a runtime env FLAG_PERMISSIVE_KEY_LOOKUP on auth-service but it's off in prod. We can toggle via k8s rollout restart with new config. Risk: slightly increased latency due to remote calls but minimal.

deploy-bot: [deploy-trigger] user mike-oncall triggered config patch on deployment auth-service-prod (image: auth:v3.4.1)

mike-oncall: patch applied, rolling restart triggered, enabling FLAG_PERMISSIVE_KEY_LOOKUP=true. Monitoring...

(almost real-time)

mike-oncall: within 3 minutes error rate dropped from 9% -> 1.3%. Customers reporting partial recovery. Still seeing edge cases where older session tokens fail.

jenn a-cs: CoveHealth confirms reduced errors but some endpoints still 401. They provided token samples and timestamps.

aaron-eng: I started the KMS restore job for v2. ETA about 22 minutes to make key available and then replicate to keyservice. After that, we should remove permissive flag and re-run cache invalidation properly.

alisha-infra: starting targeted cache flush for replay and kid maps in region-us-west. Command: `redis-cli -h redis-prod-us-west --scan --pattern "replay_cache:kid:v2:*" | xargs redis-cli -h redis-prod-us-west del`

mike-oncall: rolling through the list of affected customers to confirm when each gets cleared. Logging notes and escalation status.

(15m later)

alisha-infra: KMS restore completed and keyservice now exposes v2 again. Propagation confirmed on all regions.

aaron-eng: revalidated tokens against restored v2 — local cache now accepts them. Recommendation: keep permissive flag on for 10 more minutes and then disable after one full propagation cycle.

mike-oncall: disabling FLAG_PERMISSIVE_KEY_LOOKUP now. rolling restart to remove the flag.

deploy-bot: [deploy-complete] auth-service-prod rollout complete (revision r1532 -> r1533)

mike-oncall: monitoring... 401 rate back to baseline (0.25%). CoveHealth, AcmeML, Ledgerly confirm recovery.

jenna-cs: summarizing for tickets: root cause — key rotation removed v2 mapping before caches/replica invalidation completed, resulting in signature verification failures for tokens signed with v2. Mitigation — enabled permissive runtime lookup to allow remote validation, restored v2 private key from KMS, flushed region caches, disabled permissive mode once stable.

sam-product: action items — add pre-rotation cache quiesce step to rotation playbook, add health check that validates a small sample of previously-issued tokens during rotation, and increase rotation propagation window by default to 5m. Also add a customer-facing incident note template for auth regressions.

lucy-support: I'll update all open tickets with status and RCA draft. Will ask affected customers if they need token re-issue or if restored mapping is sufficient.

aaron-eng: follow-ups for engineering: add more robust reconciliation job that ensures keyservice and validator caches converge before deleting old keys. Also add telemetry to detect sudden jump in token signature failures keyed by kid.

mike-oncall: postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll capture metrics and timeline. For now, closing incident channel when people ack.

jenna-cs: ack from support. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
